messages:
jade (Docs): Heads-up — PR #3421 is ready for review, it normalizes 'role' vs 'persona' naming across guides. Looking for quick consensus on the preferred term and glossary mapping.

sasha (PM): Thanks! My read: use 'persona' for end-user archetypes, and 'role' for system-level tags (e.g., 'assistant', 'system'). We should call out the distinction on product pages. :thinking_face:

kevin (Eng): Agree on the distinction. One engineering constraint: don't break API/SDK params. Suggest we keep API param named `role` but surface `persona` in UX copy and examples where helpful.

liam (ML): FWIW we use `role` in most prompt/eval recipes. Switching docs wholesale to 'persona' will confuse ML folks. Propose we treat 'role' as canonical for technical docs and mention 'persona' as the user-facing synonym.

jade (Docs): Sounds like a pragmatic split. Proposal: canonical term in docs = 'role' (technical examples), product/marketing = 'persona'. Update glossary entry to include both terms and set canonical_id = ROLE_V1. Add a short migration note in the PR for callers.

kevin (Eng): I'll update the SDK examples in the PR to keep `role` as the param and add an inline comment that 'persona' == 'role' in UX. Will push a tiny commit to #3421.

sasha (PM): Also add an i18n note — translators default to 'persona' in some locales. We should include guidance in the glossary so localization teams know which string to prefer.

docs-bot: CI: docs-lint passed for PR #3421 — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3421

jade (Docs): Action items: kevin -> update examples and add inline comment; sasha -> add i18n note; liam -> short eval guidance; jade -> update glossary entry + migration snippet. Target EOD Friday.

kevin (Eng): ACK. Pushed commit 9f3a2c, added python snippet: ```python
# keep SDK param as `role` (persona is UX synonym)
client.generate(role='assistant')
```

liam (ML): I'll add a 2-line eval guidance tomorrow morning with example prompts showing `role` usage.

sasha (PM): Please also add a one-liner for the release notes so PMs and CSMs can communicate the change.

jade (Docs): Will add release-note blurb and link to glossary id ROLE_V1. Plan to merge once CI is green and kevin's commit is squashed. :+1:
